column2: <color=#80ff80>The world now holds only values from the game's menu — by modifiers the world is not «cheated».</color>
<color=#ff8060>The world already holds values that are not from the game's menu, which make it «cheated»:
. You can remove them in «Settings» → «Achievements» → «Clean the world». They are not changed here.</color>
<color=#ffd080>Only the world host can change these; you see the current values.</color>
The mod's loot multiplier (mobs, chests, trees, ore)

<color=#c0c0c0>Works on top of the «Resources» modifier below: that one is for the whole world and only with the game's options, this one is in your game, up to ×10, and doesn't touch the world modifiers, so it doesn't touch achievements either. Loot is counted by the game of whoever killed the mob or opened the chest, so with sync («Time and weather») the multiplier works for both of you.</color>
<color=#c0c0c0>A preset only fills in the choice below; nothing changes until you click «Apply».</color>
<color=#c0c0c0>Changes apply at once for all players and are saved with the world.</color>

The mod's own layer on top of the game's settings. It changes only how the base is drawn and sounds, not what happens in it: buildings, support, wear, fire, smoke and furnaces work exactly as in the game, so achievements and the world's «fairness» are not affected. • Instancing: identical walls, beams and floors go to the graphics card in batches. • Small things far away: what is smaller than a few pixels on screen is not drawn, and small things cast no shadow. • Fire out of view: particles of fires you can't see are paused, distant lights don't flicker. • Sound: crackling fires and humming stations you can no longer hear are paused. • Light budget: when there are more lights than the limit, the least noticeable go out (off-screen first), the ones close to you always burn; shadows — only for the most noticeable.
Don't draw small things far away and remove their shadows
Put fire out of view to sleep, distant lights without flicker

Stand where it lags and don't move: the menu closes, the result appears at the top left and here.\n• Detailed test (≈55 s): FPS without the layer, then each function alone, all together and again without the layer. You see what gives a gain and what doesn't.\n• The mod itself (≈26 s): turns off the mod's components (menu, map, storage, keys); the game patches are one-line checks, they stay.
How much the mod itself takes

<color=#c0c0c0>For 8 seconds every stage of the Unity frame (physics, scripts, particles, rendering, interface) and the game's main systems are measured: buildings, network, characters, smoke, sound. The menu closes during the measurement. The result is also written to ValheimHelper.log.</color>

<color=#c0c0c0>Everything lying around within the radius: drops from mobs, felled trees, broken rocks. The game itself picks it up, as if you pressed E at each pile: only what fits by space and weight. Weapons don't go into your hands by themselves.</color>

<color=#c0c0c0>All status effects of the game: Forsaken powers, potions and meads, set bonuses, rested, negative ones. An effect is applied by the game's own mechanism, so achievements are not affected. Some effects (wet, cold, shelter) are removed by the game at once if their condition is missing. Choose the duration before «Apply»: «Until I remove it» keeps renewing the timer until you click «Remove». For a friend the duration is set if they have this version of Valheim Helper too, otherwise it is as in the game; removing from a friend also works only then.</color>
<color=#c0c0c0>Effects are applied to you. Choose a friend at the top to apply to them or teleport to them.</color>
<color=#80ff80>{0} has Valheim Helper:</color> <color=#c0c0c0>you can apply and remove effects and teleport to them wherever they are.</color>

<color=#ffb040>{0} doesn't have this version of Valheim Helper:</color> <color=#c0c0c0>you can apply effects (it's the game's own command) but not remove them. Teleport works if they are near, you are the host or they show themselves on the map.</color>
This will appear once you enter the world.

<color=#c0c0c0>Stand in the middle of your storage and click «Put away» (or assign a key in «Settings» → «Keys»). Every item goes where you (or a friend with the mod) last put it by hand, even if that chest is empty now. Next — into the chest where it already lies: first it tops up incomplete stacks, then it goes beside them in the same row. A new item goes to its group (kinds of wood to wood, ore to metals) or into the chest of its biome; a chest with a purpose takes only its own.\nWhat finds no room the mod lays out into empty chests in shelves: wood, stone, metals, trophies, biome materials — each shelf in its own chest, neighbouring shelves side by side. Don't like where it went? Move it by hand — the chest will remember. Items marked «keep» stay with you.</color>
Put items from the inventory into chests nearby
<color=#909090>This radius is for everything «nearby»: putting away, furnaces, crafting and building from chests, and from the storage centre — for orders from afar.</color>
Lay out into empty chests what finds no room
Chests remember what is put into them by hand
<color=#ffb040>The storage centre is not set: without it you can't see what the storage holds when you are away, and can't order.</color>

<color=#c0c0c0>«Show» highlights the chests with this item (when you are near). «Deliver» — the item flies to you wherever you are: ≈25 m/s (1 km — 40 s), from 15 s to 4 min, the flight is shown on the map; what doesn't fit into the inventory lands next to you. Chests someone has opened, chests a friend stands next to, or other players' personal chests are not touched. The host sees the storage and carries out orders, so they need this version of Valheim Helper.</color>
<color=#909090>The list is too long, not everything is shown — narrow the search.</color>
Show the amount picker next to the crafting window

<color=#c0c0c0>To the right of the crafting window, level with the «Craft» button, appear «−», the amount, «+» and «Max» (they cover nothing). «+» and «−» change by 1, with Shift by 10; the mouse wheel over them works too. «Max» is as many as the materials (together with chests nearby, if that is on below) and inventory space allow. Click the number to go back to 1. The game itself crafts, as with Shift held (where it is always 5): materials, skill experience and bonus items — for every piece. The amount is not shown for upgrading items. Another recipe or a closed window — back to 1.</color>
Count materials in chests nearby when crafting
Count materials in chests nearby when building with the hammer (and planting with the cultivator)

<color=#c0c0c0>«Nearby» means within the storage radius, now {0:0} m (changed in «Base» → «Storage»).\nIn the crafting window (any station or crafting by hand) and with the hammer in your hands, materials in chests around you count as yours: recipes and buildings light up as available, and a material's icon reads «need/have», for example 8/135, where «have» is the inventory together with the chests. When you click «Craft» or place a building, the mod takes from the nearest chests only what the inventory lacks, and the game spends it as usual. Only the game decides which recipes and buildings are unlocked: the mod unlocks nothing. If another player has opened a chest, nothing is taken from it.</color>
Put what smelters, kilns, the windmill, the spinning wheel and the refinery make into a chest nearby

<color=#c0c0c0>A bar (coal, flour…) goes into a chest within the storage radius ({0:0} m from the furnace) where you last put such an item by hand, or if there is none — into the chest where it already lies. No such chest or no room in it — it drops from the furnace as usual. Works when your game «owns» the furnace (you are near, or the host with no other players near it); for a friend without the mod everything drops as usual.</color>

<color=#c0c0c0>Puts into every furnace within the storage radius ({0:0} m) everything it processes and fuel for it: first from the inventory, and what is missing — from chests nearby. The checkboxes below decide which furnaces to load. Each furnace takes only as much as fits, and of several materials — the one you have most of (ordinary wood before valuable wood). Ore is shared equally so all furnaces work. Exactly as much fuel goes in as the ore in the furnace needs (say, 2 coal per 1 iron ore), without a reserve. Items marked «keep» are not taken, so marked wood won't burn in a kiln.</color>

<color=#c0c0c0>Mark items the mod must not take out of the inventory, neither into chests, nor into furnaces, nor into torches: tools, food, anything. The rest is moved. What you wear and hold is never touched.\nYou can also mark them right in the inventory: assign the key «Keep: the item under the cursor» in «Settings» → «Keys», open the inventory, point at an item and press it. Marked items show a padlock in the inventory.</color>

<color=#c0c0c0>You can tell an empty chest in advance what it will hold. A chest with a purpose takes only its group or its biome (and what already lies in it). Friends with Valheim Helper see the purpose; in a game without the mod it's an ordinary chest.</color>
